description:
Upload a new electronic form (eForm) template into the Oscar EMR system. 

Goal: Install the 'Rapid Pain Assessment' tool.

Instructions:
1. Log in to Oscar EMR with username 'oscardoc', password 'oscar', PIN '1117'.
2. Navigate to the Administration panel (often labeled 'Admin').
3. Locate 'eForm Management' or 'Manage eForms'.
4. Add/Upload a new eForm.
5. Set the Form Name to 'Rapid Pain Assessment'.
6. Upload the HTML file located at '/home/ga/Documents/pain_assessment.html'.
7. Save/Register the form and ensure it is active.
